purpose: Mark a starting point in formal notices or correspondence.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Time / place / source N + より
Registration begins at nine in the morning.
A special bus departs from Tokyo Station.
The person in charge will provide further details.
formation: Time / place / source N + より
restrictions: This use corresponds to から, rather than the comparison “than”.
mistake: Context distinguishes a source or start from a comparison standard.
